== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[DS-61-4 (PC Errata 2013 disc card)]]. Compared with [[DS-61-4 (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the same area of the 2013 disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
